study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
cohort: 356 pregnant women with GDM and type 2 DM
finding: Obesity did not worsen pregnancy outcomes in women with GDM and type 2 DM, suggesting that obese women may not require more stringent antepartum treatment strategies.
mod_finding: This study found that obesity did not worsen pregnancy outcomes in women with gestational diabetes and type 2 diabetes, and that cesarean section rates were similar between obese and non-obese women.
